jobs.title: General Manager - Citizens Bank Park
jobs.description:
Job Description

Aramark Sports & Entertainment is looking to hire a new General Manager to support our food and beverage operations at Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia, PA.

THE OPPORTUNITY: As a General Manager, you will plan, manage, and lead multiple contracted services with multi-million dollar revenue to meet operating and financial goals, client objectives, and guest needs. Services include F&B and merchandise operations which could include concessions, catering, premium dining and retail merchandise services. This position will support and be responsible for executing large sports events, concerts, catering, and other large venue special events. The General Manager will report to the onsite RDM with a team of salaried direct reports. This position is salaried, plus bonus eligible, contingent on achieving certain financial and performance goals.

WHO YOU ARE: Our General Managers are best-in-class operation managers who lead a team to provide excellent service to our clients and guests. Being in sync with our clients vision, strong relationship-building skills, financial acumen, and a commitment to safety, our leaders make a difference every day. Ideal candidates have managed large revenue accounts, make data-based decisions, and have extensive experience with financial analytics and forecasting.

If hired, employee will be in an "at-will position" and Aramark reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time AND FOR ANY REASON, including, BUT NOT LIMITED TO for reasons related to individual performance, Aramark or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

We take a balanced approach to benefits.

We designed our benefits to promote a culture of health and wellbeing. No one knows what you need better than you, so we provide you with the necessary tools to help you take care of your health, family, finances and future. Click here to learn more.

Job Responsibilities

- Full P&L responsibility in regard to food and beverage
- Manage the client relationship at the location, while providing hands-on execution and leadership of operations.
- Leadership of a large team of managers and workforce throughout multiple units and concepts.
- Developing new concepts to increase existing revenue sources for public foods/concessions, premium service, and catering outlets.
- Partner with the Senior General Manager and regions District Manager to plan and execute business development strategy for growth.
- Recruitment and development of new and existing managers.
- Interact successfully with the client, stadium guests, and team members on a regular basis.
At Aramark, developing new skills and doing what it takes to get the job done make a positive impact for our employees and for our customers. In order to meet our commitments, job duties may change or new ones may be assigned without formal notice.

Qualifications

- Minimum 5+ years of large venue or multi-unit management experience is required.
- Premium and Concessions Management experience preferred.
- Direct P&L responsibility within a comparably scoped environment
- Ability to lead a large team of culinary & operations managers in a high volume, fast-paced environment.
- The ability to lead in a complex environment with a keen focus on client and guest service, entrepreneurship, while building and growing a strong business is essential to success in this role.
- A passion for food & beverage with an ability to identify and develop successful concepts. Ability to communicate effectively with clients and senior management.
- Ability to respond effectively to changing demands. P&L accountability and/or contract-managed service experience is desirable.
- Candidate must be willing to be hands-on with staff and operations and be willing to work flexible hours that include evenings, weekends and holidays

This role may have physical demands including, but not limited to, lifting, bending, pushing, pulling and/or extended walking and standing. This role may also require uniforms and/or usage of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

jobs.title: Director of Strategy & Capital Management - Travel/Remote
jobs.description:
About Aramark Engineering Solutions

Aramark Engineering Solutions (ES) delivers comprehensive engineering, architecture, capital planning, program management, commissioning, energy management, and construction advisory services to clients across higher education, healthcare, workplace experience, corrections, cultural institutions, sports & entertainment, and government markets.

As Aramark's enterprise capital delivery organization, ES partners with clients throughout the entire asset lifecycle-from strategic planning and facility assessments through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, occupancy, and long-term asset optimization. Leveraging a multidisciplinary team of engineers, architects, project managers, construction professionals, and technical specialists, ES delivers innovative, data-driven capital solutions that maximize facility performance, improve operational efficiency, reduce lifecycle costs, and enhance the client experience.

With a proven track record managing billions of dollars in capital investments and delivering measurable operational value, ES continues to advance Aramark's commitment to operational excellence, strategic growth, and world-class capital program delivery.

Job Description

The Director of Strategy & Capital Management serves as the strategic and operational leader of Aramark's Capital Management Design & Construction (CMDC) organization. Reporting to the National Director , Engineering Solutions and Enterprise Capital Management Office (ECPMO). this position is responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously improving the enterprise-wide capital management strategy supporting all Aramark Lines of Business.

This executive leadership role provides strategic oversight of capital planning, portfolio management, project governance, financial controls, PMO operations, business analytics, vendor management, organizational performance, and capital delivery processes. The Director establishes standardized methodologies, business processes, governance frameworks, and performance metrics that ensure capital programs are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, within budget, and aligned with enterprise objectives.

The Director leads a multidisciplinary organization responsible for enterprise capital planning, capital program management, financial governance, procurement oversight, portfolio reporting, project controls, resource planning, and continuous process improvement. Working collaboratively with executive leadership, operations, finance, procurement, design, construction, and external partners, this individual develops long-range capital investment strategies that maximize client value while supporting Aramark's continued growth.

Job Responsibilities

- Provide strategic leadership for Aramark's enterprise-wide Capital Management, Design, and Construction (CMDC) function, ensuring capital investments align with organizational objectives, client needs, and long-term growth strategies. Lead the development and execution of enterprise capital planning, investment prioritization, portfolio optimization, and capital deployment strategies across all lines of business.
- Establish and maintain governance frameworks, project delivery standards, and portfolio management processes that drive consistency, accountability, and operational excellence.
- Oversee enterprise capital financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, capital authorization, financial reporting, cost controls, and performance measurement.
- Direct the planning, execution, and performance of complex capital programs and project portfolios, ensuring successful delivery of scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk objectives.
- Lead and develop multidisciplinary teams spanning program management, project controls, portfolio management, financial analysis, procurement, and administrative support functions.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership by providing strategic recommendations, investment analyses, portfolio insights, risk assessments, and performance reporting.
- Foster strong partnerships with clients, operations, finance, procurement, engineering, design, construction, and business development stakeholders to achieve enterprise objectives.
- Provide executive oversight of strategic supplier relationships, professional services, contractors, consultants, and vendor programs to optimize quality, cost, and delivery performance.
- Champion process standardization, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives that enhance efficiency, governance, and project outcomes across the organization.
- Develop and monitor enterprise performance metrics, dashboards, and analytics to drive data-based decision-making, resource optimization, portfolio health, and return on capital investment.
- Promote a culture of accountability, employee engagement, talent development, succession planning, and high-performance leadership throughout the organization.
- Partner with Business Development, Operations, and Executive Leadership to identify, quantify, and execute capital investment opportunities that support client retention, account growth, new business pursuits, mergers and acquisitions, and enterprise expansion initiatives.
- Support sales and client solutions efforts by developing capital strategies, facility investment roadmaps, and value propositions that strengthen Aramark's competitive position and drive revenue growth.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Business, Finance, or a related discipline.
- Master's degree (MBA, Engineering Management, Construction Management, or related field) preferred.
- Professional certifications such as PMP, CCM, DBIA, PE, RA, LEED AP , or equivalent are highly desirable.
- 15+ years of progressive leadership experience managing enterprise capital programs, construction organizations, or large-scale project portfolios.
- Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary teams across multiple geographic regions.
- Experience managing portfolios exceeding $150M+ annually with executive-level financial accountability.
- Proven ability to build high-performing organizations, implement enterprise PMO standards, and drive measurable operational improvements.

jobs.title: Facilities Operations Director
jobs.description:
Job Description

The IFM Facilities Operations Director leads and directs integrated facilities maintenance operations of building(s) and property at a multi-site unit. This position may function as head of a small mega-site unit with three levels of management reporting up to this position; or may assist in the leadership of a large mega or multi-site unit reporting to an District Manager. The Facilities Operations Director leads and assists in the integration of processes within the client organization to maintain and develop agreed services which support and improve the effectiveness of its primary activities. This position may contribute to the delivery of strategic and operational objectives by reducing facility costs, and improving the productivity, revenue generating capacity and image of the entire organization. This position ensures a safe and efficient working environment, essential to the performance of the business. The position often manages construction work and may coordinate and/or oversee contracted services for major construction. The position often manages other core Aramark services, and/or logistics of business/operations services, e.g., grounds keeping, laundry, food, security, inventory, mail, concierge services, executive fleet vehicles.

Job Responsibilities

- Directs work of management team and front-line associates
- Makes/influences employment decisions including hiring, promotions, development and performance management
- Ensures individual and team performance meets objectives and client expectations
- Provides overall direction and manages performance for all Facility and Maintenance Supervisors and front-line employees, ensuring employee development, engagement and compliance with human resource related policies and standards, including conducting applicable rounding
- Plans and leads daily team briefings
- Direct point of contact for all Aramark and sub-contracted lines of services on behalf of client
- Oversight of all work done on behalf of client to ensure quality control and hospitality focused delivery of all services
- Plans, improves, and maintains owned and leased facilities and equipment.
- Provides strategic leadership and vision for departments.
- Directs, manages and coordinates with the functional authority for planning, organization, control and integration to ensure completion of projects.
- Oversight of all site utility systems to include electrical, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment, energy management, fire safety, life safety and grounds
- Responsible for state of readiness to comply with Life Safety preparedness, OSHA, Air/ Water preparation compliance, emergency response and document requirements.
- Ensures the Client is following all local, state, and federal codes and regulations.
- 24/7 response to building related emergencies
Client relationship:
o Responsible for developing/executing maintenance solutions to meet customer needs
o Executes facilities maintenance/upkeep following predefined specifications
o Identifies client needs and communicates operational progress
o Ensures compliance with client contract and client's property lease terms
o Directly interface with Client, C-Suite Executives, Client Stakeholders
o Ability to adapt to Client's culture
Financial Performance:
o Delivers client and company financial targets

Adopts all Aramark and client processes/systems, understands performance metrics, data, orders, inventory trends and educates teams on key levers to improve margins

Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience managing Facilities Operations in Corporate Office Settings
- 10 years Management Experience
- 10 years experience in facilities management, engineering or management of business/operations
- Ability to read, understand, and apply property lease terms as well as client contracts
- Experience in leveraging modern technology and data to drive business decisions i.e. IWMS/CMMS, IoT technology, digital twins, robotics etc.
- IFMA Membership and Certification Preferred (FMP, SFP, CFM)

jobs.title: General Manager-Service Industry
jobs.description:
Job Description

Best Beverage Equipment Service is a specialized equipment service business supporting internal Aramark operations and external customers through field service, equipment refurbishment, technical support, and client contact center operations.

The General Manager is responsible for the overall performance, growth, and continued development of the business. This leader will operate with an ownership mentality, translating business priorities into disciplined execution, measurable results, and an exceptional customer experience.

Leading through a team of Service Managers and a Contact Center Manager, the General Manager has responsibility for field technicians, refurbishment operations, service dispatch and customer support. The role owns the day-to-day business, including revenue growth, profitability, client retention, service execution, safety, employee engagement, labor productivity, fleet readiness, inventory control, and operational efficiency.

The General Manager will strengthen and expand existing customer relationships while identifying opportunities to grow Best Beverage's services with internal Aramark partners and external customers. Success requires a leader who can balance hands-on operational involvement with long-term business development, build capable leaders, use data to improve performance, and create an operation that can grow without sacrificing service quality.

This is an in-person role, and remote or hybrid work arrangements are not available.

Business and Operational Leadership

- Own overall performance of Best Beverage Equipment Service, including revenue, profitability, margin, labor, operating expenses, inventory, capital requirements, and financial controls.
- Develop and execute annual operating plans, budgets, forecasts, and performance-improvement strategies aligned with organizational goals.
- Partner with Finance to understand results, identify performance gaps and unfavorable trends, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Establish clear operating expectations, performance routines, accountability measures, and timely, accurate operational and financial reporting.
- Use financial, operational, workforce, and customer data to identify risks, prioritize resources, and make informed business decisions.
- Identify opportunities to improve labor productivity, technician utilization, routing, fleet efficiency, parts management, inventory control, and cost-to-serve.
- Provide overall leadership for field service, equipment refurbishment, dispatch, client support, and contact center operations.
- Lead through Managers, ensuring alignment, consistency, accountability, and effective execution across functions.
- Establish and monitor service standards for response time, work-order completion, first-time fix rate, repeat service calls, preventive maintenance, equipment uptime, customer communication, and backlog.
- Ensure work is properly assigned, scheduled, documented, completed, and closed accurately and efficiently.
- Maintain appropriate staffing, scheduling, fleet, tools, parts, and equipment resources to meet current service commitments and support future growth.
- Promote proactive service models that reduce downtime, prevent repeat issues, and improve customer experience.
- Ensure refurbishment operations produce safe, reliable, customer-ready equipment while maximizing asset value and controlling cost.
- Ensure installations and service projects are appropriately scoped, priced, resourced, scheduled, communicated, and completed on time and within financial expectations.
- Regularly engage with employees and leaders in the field to understand operating conditions, remove barriers, reinforce expectations, and validate execution.
- Lead implementation of new processes, systems, service capabilities, and operational initiatives, and develop scalable practices that support growth while maintaining quality, safety, responsiveness, and financial discipline.

Growth, People, Safety, and Compliance

- Develop and execute strategies to retain, strengthen, and expand customer relationships and serve as a senior point of contact for key customers, business partners, and internal stakeholders.
- Build a strong understanding of customer operations, equipment needs, service expectations, contractual commitments, satisfaction trends, and future business opportunities.
- Identify opportunities to expand Best Beverage services across Aramark businesses, National Accounts, Market Centers, and external customers aligned with the organization's capabilities and strategy.
- Partner with Sales, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, National Accounts, and other functions on proposals, service solutions, pricing strategies, and implementation plans.
- Ensure new business is operationally supportable, appropriately priced, and aligned with labor, technical capabilities, geographic coverage, and financial expectations.
- Expand technical and service capabilities based on customer needs, market opportunities, and long-term business strategy.
- Develop strategic relationships with equipment manufacturers, parts suppliers, and service partners to improve technical support, parts availability, warranty recovery, service capability, and cost.
- Lead recovery plans for underperforming accounts, service failures, or customer relationships requiring immediate intervention.
- Build, develop, and retain a high-performing management team and establish clear expectations for operational results, people leadership, communication, safety, and customer experience.
- Maintain regular business reviews, manager one-on-ones, field observations, and performance-management routines.
- Ensure leaders effectively manage staffing, onboarding, technical training, certification, scheduling, productivity, performance, employee relations, succession planning, and development.
- Foster a culture of ownership, urgency, teamwork, accountability, continuous improvement, respect, recognition, and employee engagement.
- Partner with Human Resources and Talent Acquisition to maintain an effective workforce plan and sustainable pipeline of technical and leadership talent.
- Maintain a strong safety culture across field service, refurbishment, vehicle operations, equipment handling, and customer locations.
- Ensure compliance with Aramark policies, the Business Conduct Policy, customer requirements, manufacturer standards, and applicable laws and regulations.
- Maintain disciplined fleet-management practices and ensure required safety, technical, equipment, driver, and compliance training is completed.
- Maintain accurate records related to work orders, customer assets, inventory, certifications, training, fleet, safety, and other operational requirements.
- Investigate incidents, service failures, asset losses, and compliance concerns; identify root causes and ensure corrective actions are completed.
- Protect company and customer assets, information, equipment, inventory, and funds, and proactively identify and escalate significant operational, financial, safety, workforce, and customer risks.

At Aramark, developing new skills and doing what it takes to get the job done make a positive impact for our employees and customers. To meet our commitments, job duties may change or new ones may be assigned without formal notice.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technical Services, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
- Significant leadership experience in field service, equipment repair, technical services, facilities, route-based operations, contract services, or a related service industry.
- Demonstrated experience leading through other managers and holding leaders accountable for both operational and people results.
- Proven ability to manage a business, department, or operating unit with responsibility for revenue, expenses, labor, profitability, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
- Experience developing customer relationships, retaining business, resolving escalated service concerns, and identifying growth opportunities.
- Strong operational judgment and the ability to balance immediate customer needs with safety, workforce capacity, financial expectations, and long-term business priorities.
- Ability to use operational and financial reporting, dashboards, service systems, and performance data to identify trends and drive action.
- Experience improving service delivery, labor productivity, customer satisfaction, workflow management, and operating consistency.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence employees, managers, customers, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners.
- Demonstrated ability to lead change, establish structure, improve accountability, and scale an evolving business.
- Working knowledge of field service systems, work-order management, dispatch, fleet operations, parts and inventory control, and equipment lifecycle management is strongly preferred.
- Ability and willingness to travel to customer locations, field operations, and other business sites as required.

jobs.description:

The Senior Finance Manager will be a key team leader and directly accountable for the operating and accounting controls of the locations assigned.
- This role will be available to work event-based hours, provide supervision, direction and maintain visible supportive leadership presence.

Job Description

The Unit Controller supports the financial objectives of the accounting and finance department by overseeing critical financial operations and assisting operating departments with budgeting, forecasting, inventory control, and financial analysis. This role is responsible for ensuring financial compliance and accuracy while providing insights to support the unit's performance. Additionally, the Unit Controller plays an integral part in operational responsibilities for the unit, ensuring that financial practices align with the overall strategic goals.

Scope of Role:

The Unit Controller is accountable for managing the financial close process, cash flow, accounts receivable, accounts payable, fixed assets, and capital expenditures. The role requires leadership in the budgeting and forecasting processes, as well as collaboration with senior management to ensure effective financial decision-making. The Unit Controller also participates in special projects, contract negotiations, and compliance with local, state, and federal regulations.

Job Responsibilities

- Oversee cash flow, cash and banking, accounts receivable, accounts payable, fixed assets, and capital expenditures.
- Manage the weekly and monthly accounting close process to ensure financial accuracy.
- Analyze financial performance and provide actionable insights to support operational leadership.
- Lead the weekly financial roll-up process.
- Oversee the budgeting and forecasting process with input from senior on-site management.
- Provide ad hoc reporting and analysis for clients as required.
- Participate in special projects, including contract negotiations and operational changes.
- Ensure all financial records and reports adhere to Aramark's Business Conduct Policy and comply with local, state, and federal regulations.
- Train and develop operations teams on financial acumen and adherence to financial policies.

Technical Knowledge :

- Proficiency in financial systems and strong Microsoft Excel skills.
- In-depth knowledge of financial processes, including cash flow management, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and profit and loss (P&L) management.
- Understanding of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) and financial controls.
- Experience in managing financial reporting, budgeting, and forecasting processes.

Qualifications

Technical Knowledge:
- Proficiency in financial systems and strong Microsoft Excel skills.
- In-depth knowledge of financial processes, including cash flow management, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and profit and loss (P&L) management.
- Understanding of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) and financial controls.
- Experience in managing financial reporting, budgeting, and forecasting processes.

Key Attributes:
- Minimum of 3-5 years of progressive financial experience, preferably in AP/AR, payroll, and P&L management or relevant industry experience.
- Bachelor's degree in finance or accounting preferred.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to present financial insights clearly to stakeholders.
- High attention to detail and ability to meet strict deadlines.
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to take initiative in a fast-paced environment.
- Willingness to work event-based hours, including evenings and weekends.
- Ability to meet physical demands such as lifting, bending, pushing, pulling, and standing for extended periods.
- Compliance with uniform requirements and use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as needed.

jobs.title: Maintenance General Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

As a Maintenance General Manager you will provide overall vision, planning, direction, and control to assigned sites for a defined account. This key leadership role is accountable for execution of our General Management program, with a focus on growth, cost and productivity, leading people and delivering financial commitments. Key success measures include Revenue Growth, EBIT, Margin, Customer Satisfaction, Client Loyalty and Employee Engagement.

Leadership - Overall ownership and accountability of operational management and financial performance of multiple accounts and units. Model key leadership behaviors and ensure the highest levels of safety, quality and service excellence for employees, clients, and customers. Coach employees by creating a shared understanding about what needs to be achieved and how it is to be achieved. Reward and recognize employees (examples or programs) Identify, develop and engage top talent and coach team members to their fullest potential within the organization. Plan and lead team management meetings. Ensure HS&E standards in all operations and that those standards meet or exceed client metrics.

Client Relationship - Establish and maintain effective client and customer rapport for a mutually beneficial business relationship. Identify client needs and communicate operational progress. Facilitate and support new business and retention activities. Ensure unit managers execute customer satisfaction surveys in all locations. Ensure timely and accurate monthly site level business reviews with client site Leadership. Support Account Leadership in the development of timely and accurate QBRs with the requisite date and performance data. Responsible for all contractual obligations at the assigned sites which would include KPI performance .

Financial Performance - Build revenue and manage budget which includes cost controls. Ensure the completion and maintenance of P&L statements for the district. Oversight and responsibility to deliver client and company financial targets. Ensure adoption of all Aramark processes and systems, eliminate custom/manual reports. Understand performance metrics, data, order and inventory trends; educate teams on key levers to improve margins.

Productivity - Lead managers in implementing and maintaining corporate management agenda (what is the corporate management agenda?). Ensure value through efficient operations, appropriate cost controls, and profit management. Ensure consistent application of Aramark's operating standards and processes (Operational Excellence) Understand end to end supply chain and procurement process and systems; ensure only authorized suppliers are used.

Compliance - Ensure unit managers maintain a safe and healthy environment for clients, customers and employees. Comply with all applicable policies, rules and regulations, including but not limited to those relating to safety, health, and wage and hour. Meet or exceed all client HSE and security procedures and metrics.

Qualifications

We are seeking a candidate with a demonstrated rapid career progression and 5+ years management experience in an industrial or manufacturing multi-site role. Total managed volume of 10 million dollars or more, and P/ L management experience in the facility management industry is desired. Contract-managed, facility management experience is desirable.
Critical to your success and the success of your area, the ideal candidate will possess:

· A proven track record of successfully managing and growing accounts along with meeting client contractual obligations
· Highly developed interpersonal, analytical and communication (written and verbal) skills.
· The ability to manage in a diverse environment with focus on client and customer services.
· The ability to develop team members to their full potential.
· A Bachelor's Degree or higher is required for this position.
· Previous experience successfully managing clients with O&M service scopes and multiple sites in an industrial, life sciences or manufacturing environment is required
· Extensive experience with mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) O&M standards and procedures is required
· A strong understand of the development of maintenance strategies and O&M capital planning strategies across multiple sites
· Experience working in an environment that requires Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)
· Demonstrated working knowledge, experience and success working in manufacturing environments that require a high degree of safety standards, protocols and procedures.

jobs.title: General Manager - Eger Healthcare & Rehabilitation
jobs.description:
Job Description

If you're a culinary leader who loves being in the kitchen, mentoring teams, creating great food, and building meaningful relationships with residents, this could be the opportunity for you.

At Aramark SeniorLIFE+, we believe dining is about more than meals. It's about comfort, connection, hospitality, and creating moments that brighten someone's day. Our teams have the privilege of serving seniors across independent living, assisted living, skilled nursing, rehabilitation, and memory care communities, helping residents feel cared for through every dining experience.

We're looking for a General Manager to lead dining services for our partnership with ArchCare Carmel Richmond in Staten Island, NY, supporting approximately 300 residents across the communities. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for leading a complex healthcare dining operation while supporting a recent account transition and building a culture centered on hospitality, accountability, and service excellence. Unlike many traditional General Manager roles, this position is highly focused on the culinary and resident experience. We're seeking a leader who enjoys being actively engaged with the food, visible with the team, and present with residents.

In this role, you'll lead all aspects of the dining program, including culinary execution, food quality, resident satisfaction, team development, financial performance, compliance, and client relationships. You'll partner closely with residents, families, clinical teams, and community leadership while ensuring the operation remains survey-ready, financially sound, and focused on delivering exceptional dining experiences every day.

Success in this role requires strong food service leadership experience, a passion for serving seniors, and the ability to build meaningful relationships with residents, families, clients, and team members. Experience within senior living, healthcare, long-term care, rehabilitation, hospitality, or other high-volume foodservice environments is highly valued. If you believe great food and genuine hospitality can make a difference in someone's quality of life, we'd like to meet you.

Compensation Data

COMPENSATION: The Salaried rate for this position is $90,000 to $100,000. If both numbers are the same, that is the amount that Aramark expects to offer. This is Aramark's good faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation for this position as of the time of posting.

Job Responsibilities

- Operational Leadership
- Lead all aspects of the dining services operation, including culinary execution, food quality, resident satisfaction, financial performance, and client partnership.
- Provide hands-on leadership for food production, menu execution, recipe compliance, presentation standards, and hospitality programs that create an exceptional resident dining experience.
- Maintain a visible presence throughout the kitchen and dining areas, actively supporting daily operations and continuously enhancing the resident experience.

Client & Resident Relationship Management
- Serve as the primary liaison for client leadership while building strong relationships with residents, families, clinical teams, and community stakeholders.
- Partner with residents and community leadership to identify opportunities that enhance satisfaction, elevate service, and improve the overall dining experience.

Financial Management
- Manage budgets, labor, purchasing, inventory, food costs, and operational resources to achieve financial and operational goals.
- Balance financial stewardship with a commitment to delivering exceptional food quality, hospitality, and resident satisfaction.

Compliance, Regulatory & Safety Leadership
- Ensure compliance with all food safety, sanitation, infection prevention, regulatory, and company standards while maintaining ongoing survey readiness.
- Drive a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the dining services operation.

Leadership & Team Development
- Build, coach, and develop a high-performing team of managers, chefs, cooks, and dining staff while fostering a culture of engagement, accountability, and service excellence.
- Recruit, train, retain, and develop team members, creating opportunities for professional growth and succession planning.

Healthcare Dining Leadership
- Ensure dining programs meet the needs of skilled nursing, long-term care, rehabilitation, memory care, and other resident populations, including therapeutic and specialized diets.
- Partner with culinary and operational leadership to introduce menu innovations, special events, seasonal offerings, and programs that enhance resident satisfaction.
- Champion a hospitality-focused dining culture that delivers exceptional experiences for residents, families, and guests every day.

Qualifications

In order to be prepared for this leadership role, qualified candidates will possess:
- Bachelor's degree level education highly preferred in an area of Food Service, Hospitality, Facilities, or Business Management.
- The ability to focus on client and customer services, entrepreneurship and building and growing a strong business is essential to success in this role.
- Savvy interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with clients, senior management, and Aramark support staff.
- Comfortable reading, understanding, and implementing contractual requirements, including identifying opportunities within contract terms and conditions to address operational issues.
- Meaningful experience in service industry, contract services, or hospitality environment.
- Proven ability leading through other managers.
- Experience in creating and managing a department budget, financial controls and analysis.
- Experience crafting product sales strategies and implementing operational programs and initiatives.

jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

As a General Manager you will plan, manage, and guide multiple contracted services for a client normally generating $2-15M+ in revenue to meet operating and financial goals, client objectives, and customer needs.
Depending on the client, services can include food service, facility support, custodial services, retail, lodging, transportation, and more. jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Aramark has been partnering with Amtrak for the past decade, to successfully deliver experiences that enrich and nourish lives. We accomplish this by providing warehouse logistics, inventory control, and provisioning all food service for the feature cars and special trains.

The General Manager will oversee a 24/7/365 distribution center/commissary operation. In this role, the General Manager has complete responsibility of the market which provides food and beverage services regionally to our client, Amtrak. The GM will plan, direct and control the operations of multiple commissary/warehouse operations. GM will be responsible for the development & growth of a large management team and hourly employees. The GM will also focus on meeting and exceeding operating and financial goals, client objectives, KPI metrics, and customer needs. The GM will have daily interaction with the client, client's customers and employees. This individual will be focused on ensuring operational excellence in the delivery of the services ARAMARK is contracted to provide at the account.

COMPENSATION: The salary rate for this position is $115,000 to $125,000. If both numbers are the same, that is the amount that Aramark expects to offer. This is Aramark's good faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation for this position as of the time of posting.

BENEFITS: Aramark offers comprehensive benefit programs and services for eligible employees including medical, dental, vision, and work/life resources. Additional benefits may include retirement savings plans like 401(k) and paid days off such as parental leave and disability coverage. Benefits vary by location and are subject to any legal requirements or limitations, employee eligibility status, and where the employee lives and/or works. For more information about Aramark benefits, click here Aramark Careers - Benefits & Compensation .

There is no predetermined application window for this position, the position will close once a qualified candidate is selected. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law, including, but not limited to, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the California Fair Chance Act, and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance to the extent that those laws apply to the opportunity.

Job Responsibilities

- Provide strategic leadership for warehouse operations, commissary operations, logistics, transportation, and inventory management to achieve operational goals and service-level agreements (SLAs).
- Lead high-performing teams by fostering a culture of operational excellence, accountability, safety, workforce engagement, and continuous improvement.
- Direct warehouse management, inventory control, distribution, transportation, and supply chain operations while ensuring efficient workflows and cost-effective execution.
- Ensure compliance with OSHA, DOT, food safety regulations, fleet safety programs, and all applicable regulatory requirements while promoting a safety-first culture.
- Develop, implement, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs), quality assurance programs, compliance standards, and warehouse best practices to improve operational performance.
- Drive productivity through Lean methodologies, labor management, KPI tracking, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Conduct operational, inventory, and compliance audits while implementing corrective actions that improve service delivery, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
- Lead recruiting, workforce planning, onboarding, training, coaching, succession planning, and performance management for managers, supervisors, and hourly employees.
- Develop staffing strategies that support operational growth, labor efficiency, employee retention, and leadership development.
- Oversee transportation operations, vehicle maintenance programs, DOT compliance, fleet safety, and risk management across warehouse and distribution operations.
- Develop and execute business plans, operational strategies, forecasting models, and contingency plans that support business objectives and operational excellence.
- Partner with clients and key stakeholders to communicate results, resolve service issues, and implement performance improvement initiatives.
- Manage key performance metrics including inventory turns, fill rates, order accuracy, on-time delivery, labor productivity, shrink control, operating costs, and customer satisfaction.
- Analyze P&L statements, financial forecasts, operating reports, and budget variances to identify trends, improve financial performance, and implement corrective actions.
- Maintain compliance with company policies, client contracts, quality standards, transportation regulations, government requirements, and documentation processes supporting operational excellence.

Qualifications

- Candidate must possess an undergraduate 4-year degree from an accredited university/college.
- At least 5 years of experience leading a team with a focus around business process compliance, Inventory management, financial controls and customer/client service. Preferred.
- Previous profit and loss accountability experience, and a proven track record of growing accounts is essential. Total managed volume of greater than $2M and P&L management experience in a fast paced multi-faceted operation.
- Proven experience building productive performance-based client relationships
- Ability to develop/mentor a management group into a high performing team to consistently deliver against corporate goals and client expectations.
- Ideal candidates will possess a high energy level that is communicated to the team they will lead
- Demonstrate proven success in interfacing with a variety of organizational functions and considerable negotiation skills are also needed to drive results
- The ability to manage in a diverse environment with focus on client and customer services is a key success measure
- Union experience preferred.
- Highly developed interpersonal, analytical and communication (written and verbal) skills and experience are essential for success in this role
- Candidates must possess a demonstrated attention to detail and ability to lead directly and through influence
- Prior experience training, mentoring and developing management level staff is required; experience leading 20 to 100+ person staff is preferred

jobs.title: General Manager, Facilities Management
jobs.description:
Job Description

The General Manager, Facilities provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for all custodial, grounds, and maintenance functions across a college campus. This position is responsible for delivering a safe, clean, attractive, and well-maintained environment that supports the institution's academic mission, student experience, faculty and staff needs, and campus events. The General Manager leads a diverse team of managers, supervisors, and frontline employees while ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, budget accountability, and exceptional customer service.

Job Responsibilities

- Operational Leadership
- Direct and oversee all custodial, grounds, and facility maintenance operations across campus.
- Develop and implement operational plans that align with client expectations and institutional goals.

jobs.title: Fleet Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Fleet Operations Manager

Reporting to the Sr Manager of Fleet, this role is responsible for tactical day-to-day Aramark's Fleet operations. The Fleet Operations Manager is responsible managing Aramark's assets as well as oversight of the company's third-party Fleet management partner. This role is a key collaborator with internal and external business partners in the development and evolution of a portfolio of vehicle specifications that enables optimal business performance.

Job Responsibilities

- Collaborate with Aramark's fleet management partner to direct the tactical operation of Aramark's fleet program and optimize costs and performance.
- Lead the day-to-day execution of fleet operations and administrative programs across all Lines of Business.
- Manage key fleet programs including vehicle supply chain, licensing and registration, titles, fuel cards, tolls, rentals, accident administration, and asset data management.
- Serve as an operational contact for fleet vendors and suppliers, managing performance, service levels, and issue resolution.
- Drive process improvements, operational efficiency, and customer service enhancements across the fleet program.
- Ensure accurate fleet data, regulatory compliance, and adherence to company policies and procedures.
- Develop and maintain fleet reporting, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics to support business decisions.
- Lead fleet-related projects, technology implementations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Have a working knowledge of existing fleet management policies, activities, protocols, and procedures and make enhancement recommendations that address areas of underperformance.
- Create and actively manage performance metrics and KPIs to proactively measure and report on critical areas including fleet policy compliance, asset utilization and cost, and sustainability.
- Implement best practices to maintain an inventory of company assets that allows for continual monitoring of asset health, life cycle cost analysis, and replacement planning.
- Establish collaborative relationships with Aramark's lines of business, suppliers, and various internal stakeholders (i.e. compliance, safety, HR, and legal) to support all fleet initiatives.
- Utilize available information to identify and understand issues and opportunities in the company's fleet and provide data-driven recommendations to enhance performance and safety.

Qualifications

- A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is required.
- Minimum 5 years of fleet management experience.
- Exceptional knowledge of purchasing, managing vendor/supplier relationships and strategic sourcing.
- Accomplished in leading and working within a matrix environment, building strong cross-functional and cross-operational relationships.
- Attention to detail and exceptional organization skills, with persistence and professionalism
- Demonstrated experience in leading without formal authority.
- Ability to work and think independently, possessing sound problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Responsive and client-service focused.
- Willingly accepts additional responsibility, challenging tasks, and/or projects.
- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills
- Fully proficient in MS Office applications such as Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams; experience with PowerPoint and Smartsheet a plus.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Salute Hospitality delivers dining solutions for the military. American owned and mission ready, we support service members, families, and base communities each day, with wellness built into everything we do: menus designed for strength, energy, and endurance, from chefs who treat every meal as part of the job. Capability Built. Mission Ready. Here for the Full Journey.

The Director, Operational Excellence is a senior leadership role within Aramark's Salute program - our military and defense food service brand operating across U.S. military installations nationwide. This position is responsible for driving continuous improvement, data-informed decision-making, and operational standardization across the Salute portfolio, ensuring the program operates at the highest levels of efficiency, compliance, and quality.

Combining the disciplines of operational process improvement and business intelligence, this role leads both the development of lean, scalable operational systems and the data strategy that measures and accelerates their impact. The Director partners closely with Salute operations, culinary, contracts, finance, and technology teams to identify improvement opportunities, build performance infrastructure, and translate data insights into actionable field execution.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in operational excellence methodologies, a working knowledge of data and reporting tools, and the leadership capability to drive meaningful, lasting change across a complex, geographically dispersed federal food service program.

Job Responsibilities

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

Develop and execute strategies that improve operations while aligning with program goals, company standards, and contract requirements.
Analyze workflows to identify inefficiencies and implement improvements using lean and data-driven methods.
Lead cross-functional initiatives and create standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure consistency and accuracy across locations.
Partner with regional and field teams to improve processes and overall performance.
Support change management efforts to successfully implement new tools, processes, and standards.
Oversee project execution and ensure initiatives are completed on time with measurable results.

Business Intelligence & Data Strategy

Define and manage reporting strategies aligned with business goals.
Build and enhance dashboards and reports that provide clear, real-time insights.
Use data visualization and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI) to solve problems and drive improvements.
Ensure performance metrics are accurate, scalable, and meaningful.
Collaborate across teams to prioritize high-impact, data-driven initiatives.

Performance Monitoring & KPI Management

Establish and track KPIs across operations, including food safety, labor, inventory, quality, and cost control.
Develop automated dashboards and self-service reporting tools for leadership and field teams.
Monitor trends, identify risks and opportunities, and drive timely corrective actions.
Prepare Quarterly Business Reviews with key insights for leadership.

Process Standardization & Compliance

Develop and maintain SOPs across all operational areas.
Ensure compliance with food safety standards, federal contracts, and regulatory requirements.
Conduct audits and operational reviews to ensure adherence and identify improvements.
Support safety initiatives and maintain alignment with company safety standards.

Technology & Systems Ownership

Lead improvements to operational systems and tools, including production, inventory, and reporting platforms.
Translate business needs into system enhancements in partnership with IT and technology teams.
Manage pilot programs and support successful rollout of new technologies.
Evaluate and implement equipment and technology to improve efficiency and safety.

Labor, Inventory & Cost Optimization

Improve labor models to balance staffing needs with cost efficiency.
Optimize inventory practices to reduce waste and improve utilization.
Partner with finance and operations to manage budgets and improve margins.
Identify logistics and warehousing improvements to reduce costs and increase efficiency.

Qualifications

Required
Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of progressive experience in operational excellence, continuous improvement, business intelligence, or a closely related field, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
Military experience required - active duty, reserve, or direct professional experience working with or within a military installation environment. Familiarity with the operational structure, compliance expectations, and tempo of a federal food service or contracting environment is essential.
Demonstrated expertise in lean methodologies, Six Sigma principles, and change management strategies.
Hands-on experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools, including Power BI or equivalent platforms.
Strong project management skills with a proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives to measurable results.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Ability to influence, collaborate, and motivate teams across a geographically dispersed, matrix organization.
Willingness to travel up to 50% to military installations and Aramark operational sites nationwide.

Preferred
Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification; Lean certification a plus.
PMP or equivalent project management certification.
Experience with Department of Defense (DoD) food service contracts or Government Food Service (GFS) programs.
Familiarity with military dining operations, DFAC standards, or federal food service compliance requirements.
Prior experience with Aramark, Sodexo, Compass, or a large managed services food service company.
Experience with food production software, inventory management platforms, or enterprise operational systems in a food service environment.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Salute Hospitality delivers dining solutions for the military. American owned and mission ready, we support service members, families, and base communities each day, with wellness built into everything we do: menus designed for strength, energy, and endurance, from chefs who treat every meal as part of the job. Capability Built. Mission Ready. Here for the Full Journey.

We are seeking a Senior Marketing Manager to lead and scale marketing initiatives across Aramark's Salute program - our military and defense food service brand operating across U.S. military installations nationwide. This role serves as the strategic and operational marketing lead for the Salute portfolio, responsible for building foundational programs, supporting installation-level teams, and driving consistent brand execution in a highly specialized environment.

The ideal candidate brings a strong marketing background combined with a working knowledge of the military community - its culture, structure, and the unique context of installation-based food service. This leader will partner closely with Aramark operations, culinary, and business development teams to deliver scalable marketing programs that drive engagement, participation, and revenue growth across the Salute footprint.

Job Responsibilities

Field Marketing Leadership
Lead marketing strategy and execution across all Salute program installations, ensuring consistent brand delivery and program adoption.
Manage and develop direct report(s), providing coaching and support for installation-level marketing execution.
Serve as the primary marketing partner to regional operations leaders, aligning marketing initiatives with operational and revenue goals.
Establish scalable processes, toolkits, and operating rhythms that enable field teams to execute effectively across a geographically dispersed portfolio.

Program Strategy & Execution
Develop and implement scalable marketing programs tailored to the military installation environment, driving participation, engagement, and sales growth.
Build quarterly marketing roadmaps that reflect installation size, mission tempo, seasonal events (e.g., military heritage months, deployment cycles), and Service Member audience needs.
Lead rapid promotion development and field execution to support operational priorities.
Oversee development of graphics, campaigns, and communications that reflect military culture and resonate with on-base dining audiences.

Field Enablement & Training
Create training toolkits, playbooks, and best practice guides for food service directors and site-level teams operating in a military environment.
Lead onboarding and training programs to build field marketing capabilities and improve program adoption across new and existing installations.
Partner with culinary and operations teams to translate menu innovation and nutritional initiatives into compelling installation-level marketing programs.

Consumer Experience & Insights
Drive Voice of the Consumer initiatives focused on the preferences and needs of the on-installation dining population.
Lead site assessments and collaborate with operations to develop and implement improvement plans that enhance the dining experience.
Champion storytelling and engagement initiatives that strengthen the Salute brand across installations.
Deliver reporting and performance storytelling that demonstrates program success and business impact to internal and Aramark stakeholders.
Identify opportunities to optimize programs based on performance data and consumer insights.

Contract & Business Development Support
Support the development of marketing materials and program narratives for DoD contract proposals, rebids, and renewals in partnership with the business development team.
Collaborate with business development teams to tailor marketing strategy and brand positioning for new installation pursuits.
Maintain a working knowledge of DoD contract structures and the Salute program's competitive positioning to inform marketing strategy.

Qualifications

Required
8-10+ years of marketing experience, with demonstrated leadership in field marketing, multi-site marketing, or operational marketing roles.
Familiarity with the military community - through personal background, prior work experience, or deep interest in the space. An understanding of military culture and the installation environment informs the work and strengthens program credibility.
Proven success in multi-site or multi-client environments with scalable marketing tools and programs.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across operations, culinary, and internal teams.
Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to execute in fast-paced, mission-driven environments.
Analytical mindset with experience tracking, synthesizing, and reporting on marketing performance and consumer insights.
Proficiency in PowerPoint and Canva required.

Preferred
Experience working with Department of Defense (DoD) food service contracts or Government Food Service (GFS) programs.
Familiarity with base dining, MWR (Morale, Welfare & Recreation) programs, or the broader military food service landscape.
Prior experience with large managed services food service company.
Experience supporting contract proposals or business development efforts in a government or military context.
Background in food service, hospitality, or retail marketing.

Education

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Manager of Business Development for our Corrections Division East Region is responsible for the development of the business plan based upon pivotal initiatives for our Propel360 brand. The Manager is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role and a key lead in driving the sales strategy for new accounts directly, as well as through matrixed internal and external relationships. This position will focus on driving customer acquisition through interactions with current or developed networks of top organizational leaders in various organizational settings, including premier client environments. This new Manager of Business Development will be responsible for a specific geographic territory.

This is a remote sales position with industry-leading financial rewards for top performance. 50%+ travel, including overnight, is required. Compensation will be a combination of a competitive salary plus commission. Salary $105,000 to $115,000+ commission.

Job Responsibilities

Team Leader
- Process leadership from contact through strategy, proposal, presentation, and successful conclusion.
- Influence and develop team members without formal authority.
- Demonstrate personal ownership in prospects and sales process.
- Create a competitive differential by identifying and developing the right team
- Manage efforts of proposal development with coordinator.
- Develop knowledge base to ensure proposal compliance and guiding the internal approval process (i.e., contract requirements).
Client-Focused Sales Acumen
- Research and analyze prospect/client goals and objectives.
- Develop insights that provide opportunities to teach the prospect/client innovative approaches to reach their goals and objectives.
- Deliver client-focused presentations that address client objectives and generate two-way dialogue.
- Demonstrate how Aramark's Propel360 capabilities meet identified needs and enable success.
- Gain collaborative support for customized solutions.
- Build results-focused relationships with prospective customers.
- Introduce appropriate Aramark team members to further enhance sales process.
Strategist
- Develop and lead strategy process with regard to: competitive environment; accounts sales strategy, and territory development strategy.
- Build specific sales strategies for prospects: goals, competitive position, client relations and actions to advance sales opportunities.
- Align Aramark's selling process to the prospects buying process and maintain momentum to advance the sale.
Innovator
- Help develop customer specific solutions.
- Utilize regional and national resources to help "push the envelope" towards market leadership.
- Develop and introduce tools and techniques for improved efficiency and effectiveness.
Territory Manager
- Network proactively using traditional and social media methodologies to build relationships in target accounts.
- Proactively manage territory by developing territory plans and building a pipeline of target accounts to meet current and future growth objectives.
- Research, identify, qualify, and target market potential.
- Develop access strategy to initiate contact.
- Provide appropriate market and competitive information for corporate analysis.
- Leverage territory opportunities to deliver expected results.

Qualifications

- A minimum of 5 years "high end" strategic selling experience is required
- Prior hospitality services experience and/or operational experience is preferred; sales leadership experience is also preferred.
- Knowledge of all Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat is required.
- Requires a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
- Ability to think, plan and sell strategically - possess a consultative, customer centric selling philosophy.
- Demonstrate the ability to build alliances and influence key decision makers, both internally and externally, without formal authority.
- Managing customer relationships through creative problem solving and customer savvy.
- Market awareness in a mature service industry - self-starter who requires minimal degree of direct management.
- Prior experience in contract management services - operational acumen and savvy, including pro forma development.
- Excellent written and oral communication skills - efficient organizational skills (time/territory management).
- Poised and sharp presentation skills.
- Team selling orientation and leadership skills in a non-reporting environment - the ability to "close" the deal.

The Corrections team builds food and commissary services programs that work, day after day. From a single site to a national footprint, programs sized to what you need and built to flex as that changes.

Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer for Corrections, the Vice President of Sales will be responsible for leading a team of business development professionals with a focus on municipal customers. This new leader will also be responsible for developing and implementing strategies focused on growing our Corrections business

The ideal candidate will have the ability to work and navigate within a highly matrixed management organizational culture and will collaborate with varying levels of clients, sales leaders and regional operational leaders on initiatives related to the retention and expansion of existing business opportunities as well as sourcing of new business in key areas of our portfolio. He/she will work with their respective regional leadership in Corrections to develop and leverage processes, best practices, capabilities, and relationships to accelerate growth within their respective territory. Job Responsibilities

The Director of Strategic Partnership (DSP) is the client relationship management owner of a portfolio of existing accounts within a specific geographic territory. The DSP has direct responsibility for account growth and retention through the application and execution of comprehensive, client-facing strategies in partnership with operations and functional leaders across the region. A successful DSP is a client advocate and directs and leads the efforts for advancing our market position and developing our value proposition at our existing accounts.
They are expected to provide keen analysis to:
- establish relationships with our clients.
- help identify and align with our clients' goals and aspirations.
- create customized solutions based on mutually beneficial strategic considerations.
- communicate the differential advantages of Aramark, resulting in long-term development and industry-leading client retention and growth rates.
Candidates must have a demonstrated ability to lead client engagement planning and execution and to collaborate with operations leadership and functional support partners to develop, lead, and execute customized account strategies for our existing client partners. A successful DSP must be able to proactively identify, anticipate, and communicate potential obstacles, challenges, and/or issues at a client account that could adversely impact our ability to retain the account and partner with operations leadership in developing and executing client customized retention strategies.

jobs.title: Route Sales Manager
jobs.description:
As the route sales leader; manages route sales operations and has responsibility for the route sales workforce performance. Ensures that the route sales team has adequate resources to meet daily operational demands and capitalize on base business sales opportunities. Observers and rides along on routes, providing feedback and coaching to employees on improving route sales, productivity and safety. Develops the Service STARS and Safety culture and utilizes route sales
leadership skills in building employee performance to grow base business and enhance client partnerships. Troubleshoots and resolves safety, service, and other operational problems in collaboration with sales, service and administrative functions.
Essential Job Functions
Ensures optimal route sales execution. Resolves route service issues for clients, visiting client sites when needed to follow up and/or evaluate issues. Models and leads Service STARS culture and safety leadership, and all key initiatives relating to these core values, to provide a positive Market Center environment. Owns and fosters effective communication at all levels of the organization.
Plans, schedules, assigns, and monitors daily route assignments to ensure clients are serviced per company standards and agreements. Maintains and develops workforce plans to include hiring, route coverage and performance management activities.
Manages beginning-of-day and end-of-day check-in processes, capturing, communicating and addressing key sales, service, safety, and equipment issues.
Provides route sales employees with ongoing feedback to include recognition and/or coaching on route growth opportunities, performance productivity, sales skills development, service partnerships, safety, equipment operation, routing, vehicle inspection, and client retention risk.
Reviews weekly demand/volume for routes, determines potential gains from reducing costs or changing pricing options, supports route sales employees in capturing opportunities for base business growth using Service STARS techniques.
Maintains all business records, documentation and administrative standards as required to include personnel records, delivery and invoice records, product and asset inventories, MEI/VCR data, DOT requirements, and client sales, contact and pricing communication.
Performs other administrative and route coverage duties as required.
Job Specifications
Supervisory Responsibilities
Responsible for directly supervising at least one direct report.
Education, licenses or certificates required:
Bachelor's Degree Preferred.
High School Diploma/ G.E.D required.
Must have a valid driver's license and be able to obtain DOT certification to operate DOT regulated vehicles.

-Influence and develop team members without formal authority -Demonstrate personal ownership in prospects and sales process -Create a competitive differential by identifying and developing the right team

-Utilize regional and national resources to help "push the envelope" towards market leadership
-Develop and introduce tools and techniques for improved efficiency and effectiveness

-Network proactively using traditional and social media methodologies to build relationships in target accounts
-Proactively manage territory by developing territory plans and building a pipeline of target accounts to meet current and future growth objectives
-Research, identify, qualify, and target market potential
-Develop access strategy to initiate contact
-Provide appropriate market and competitive information for corporate analysis
-Leverage territory opportunities to deliver expected results

Aramark Nexus is hiring a Director of Business Development to help drive growth across our workforce hospitality business. This highly visible sales leadership role is responsible for identifying, developing, and advancing new business opportunities with clients in infrastructure, energy, technology, industrial, construction, remote workforce, and other complex operating environments.

The Director of Business Development will lead the sales process from prospect identification through strategy, proposal development, client presentation, negotiation, and successful close. jobs.title: Director of Strategic Partnerships - East Region
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director of Strategic Partnership (DSP) is the client relationship management owner of a portfolio of existing accounts within a specific geographic territory. The DSP has direct responsibility for account growth and retention through the application and execution of comprehensive, client-facing strategies in partnership with operations and functional leaders across the region. A successful DSP is a client advocate and directs and leads the efforts for advancing our market position and developing our value proposition at our existing accounts.

Location - This is a remote role and the next Director will be required to be located in the East region.

They are expected to provide keen analysis to:
- establish relationships with our clients.
- help identify and align with our clients' goals and aspirations.
- create customized solutions based on mutually beneficial strategic considerations.
- communicate the differential advantages of Aramark, resulting in long-term development and industry-leading client retention and growth rates.

Candidates must have a demonstrated ability to lead client engagement planning and execution and to collaborate with operations leadership and functional support partners to develop, lead, and execute customized account strategies for our existing client partners. A successful DSP must be able to proactively identify, anticipate, and communicate potential obstacles, challenges, and/or issues at a client account that could adversely impact our ability to retain the account and partner with operations leadership in developing and executing client customized retention strategies.

Job Responsibilities

- Lead external client relationship building to gain a deep and validated understanding of our clients' strategic objectives and pains.
- Lead internal relationship building to successfully partner within a matrixed organization, relying on internal subject matter experts and operational leaders to develop solutions meeting our clients' strategic objectives and pains.
- Perform objective account diagnostics and relationship analysis to ensure proactive address of retention risks and/or offering proactive innovation resulting in long-term client retention.
- Develop and manage account planning and execution strategies, annual account objectives development, thorough wiring plans, formalized client communications, client business review process, proposal development, client presentations, and contract negotiations.
- Identify growth opportunities and retention risks through the application of Aramark reporting and analysis tools.
- Be our client advocate within Aramark to proactively renew and extend contracts by developing long-term win-win value propositions with our client partners.
- Ensure client stakeholder(s) have wiring plans, meetings are scheduled and strategically executed throughout year, and documented.
- Lead the strategic account management process, ensuing key account meetings are held with region leadership each year.
- Develop an independent perspective on the strength of our partnerships through direct client engagement.
- Ensure delivery of client expectations within the contract portfolio.
- Lead RFP processes when current contracts expire or competitive bids arise within portfolio.
- Develop and lead our internal deal approval process to obtain company approval for rebids and/or vertical growth.

Qualifications

- BA/BS is required for this position. MBA preferred.
- A minimum of 5 years of account management or sales-related experience.
- Operational acumen and savvy, including technical understanding and financial proposal development.
- Experience with large clients selling complex services/solutions.
- Demonstrated excellence in written and oral communication skills.
- Knowledge of all Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience with a CRM, specifically Salesforce, and other sales enablement tools strongly preferred.
- Effective multi-tasking in a high pressure, high reward environment.
