jobs.title: Warehouse & Purchasing Manager - Aramark Nexus
jobs.description:
Job Description

Aramark Nexus is hiring a Warehouse and Purchasing Manager to lead purchasing, receiving, warehouse, inventory control, and materials management for a new, large-scale workforce community near Hereford, Texas, within driving distance of both Hereford and Amarillo.

This full-time management opportunity is a strong fit for an experienced Purchasing Manager, Procurement Manager, Warehouse Manager, Inventory Manager, Materials Manager, Receiving Manager, Supply Chain Manager, or Materials Control professional who has managed purchasing and inventory across a complex hospitality, facilities, maintenance, food service, or operational environment.

The Warehouse and Purchasing Manager will oversee the complete flow of products and materials from purchasing and receiving through storage, inventory control, internal distribution, and financial reconciliation. This includes food and beverage products as well as facilities and maintenance supplies, MRO parts, tools, equipment, housekeeping products, operating supplies, and other materials used across the site.

A major focus of this position will be establishing strong inventory controls, including FIFO, par levels, SKU optimization, cycle counts, inventory accuracy, efficient storage, product movement, requisitions, and interdepartmental transfers . The manager will also partner closely with Finance to support accounts payable, invoice processing, receiving reconciliation, budget management, and purchasing controls.

This individual will work closely with culinary, food and beverage, facilities, maintenance, housekeeping, operations, finance, and other site leaders to ensure departments have the right materials available when they are needed while controlling inventory investment, waste, and operating costs.

The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail oriented, process driven, and safety focused, with the ability to build strong working relationships with vendors, shippers, operational leaders, and peers. This role requires someone who continuously looks for opportunities to improve processes, inventory accuracy, warehouse efficiency, product flow, and overall operational performance.

Job Responsibilities

- Lead purchasing, receiving, warehouse, inventory control, and materials management activities across food service, facilities, maintenance, housekeeping, and other site operations.

- Establish and maintain strong inventory controls, including FIFO, par levels, SKU optimization, cycle counts, physical inventories, variance reconciliation, inventory accuracy, and obsolete or slow-moving inventory management .

- Maintain appropriate inventory levels for food and beverage products, maintenance and MRO parts, tools, equipment, chemicals, operating supplies, and other materials while balancing product availability with inventory investment and storage capacity.

- Oversee efficient warehouse organization, storage, staging, and product movement to support safe handling, accurate inventory, efficient space utilization, and timely distribution to operating departments.

- Manage purchase orders, approved vendors, product specifications, pricing, contract compliance, SKU compliance, requisitions, interdepartmental transfers, and purchasing system accuracy.

- Oversee receiving operations and ensure deliveries are verified against purchase orders and invoices for quantity, quality, pricing, condition, and product specifications before acceptance.

- Partner with Finance and Accounts Payable to support invoice processing, three-way matching, receiving reconciliation, pricing discrepancy resolution, credits, documentation, and timely vendor payment .

- Monitor purchasing activity and inventory investment against approved budgets, identify cost and usage variances, and maintain appropriate financial controls over purchasing and inventory activity.

- Partner with culinary, facilities, maintenance, housekeeping, operations, and finance leaders to forecast demand, establish par levels, manage departmental requisitions, and respond to changing operational requirements.

- Build effective relationships with vendors, distributors, shippers, carriers, and internal partners while proactively addressing shortages, substitutions, damaged products, delivery issues, pricing discrepancies, and service concerns.

- Maintain a strong safety culture throughout warehouse, receiving, storage, and materials-handling operations, including food safety, sanitation, FIFO, HACCP, chemical handling, equipment safety, and applicable regulatory requirements.

- Use purchasing, inventory, receiving, and operational data to drive continuous improvement , reduce waste, prevent stockouts, improve product flow, optimize SKUs, strengthen inventory accuracy, control costs, and improve warehouse productivity.

- Supervise and develop receiving, warehouse, or inventory employees as assigned, establishing clear expectations for safety, communication, accuracy, organization, accountability, and productivity.

At Aramark, developing new skills and doing what it takes to get the job done make a positive impact for our employees and our customers. In order to meet our commitments, job duties may change or new ones may be assigned without formal notice.

Qualifications

- Requires experience in purchasing, procurement, warehouse operations, receiving, inventory management, materials management, supply chain, or a related operational function .
- Previous experience as a Purchasing Manager, Procurement Manager, Warehouse Manager, Inventory Manager, Materials Manager, Receiving Manager, or similar role is preferred.
- Experience purchasing and managing inventory for multiple operational departments, including facilities, maintenance, MRO, food service, hospitality, or similar functions , is highly valued.
- Working knowledge of purchase orders, vendor management, inventory controls, receiving processes, cycle counts, par levels, and warehouse operations.
- Experience purchasing maintenance parts, tools, equipment, facilities supplies, or MRO materials is strongly preferred.
- Experience with food and beverage purchasing, receiving, storage, and food safety requirements is preferred.
- Proficiency with purchasing, inventory, ERP, warehouse management, or related business systems, along with Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
- Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, negotiation, and attention-to-detail skills.
- High school diploma or GED required. Associate or bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Hospitality, Operations, or a related field is preferred.
- Ability to work in warehouse, receiving dock, refrigerated, frozen, and operational environments and lift up to 50 pounds when required.
- Ability to work collaboratively with facilities, maintenance, culinary, food service, housekeeping, finance, and operational leadership.
- Schedule flexibility is required and may include early mornings, weekends, and holidays based on deliveries and the needs of a 24/7 operation.

About Aramark Nexus

Aramark Nexus supports large-scale workforce communities and complex projects in locations where housing, dining, facilities, and essential services are critical to keeping people and operations moving. Our teams bring together Aramark's experience and resources with an entrepreneurial approach built for fast-moving, high-growth environments.

A career with Nexus offers the opportunity to help build something from the ground up. Team members work in unique operating environments, take on meaningful responsibility, and have opportunities to grow as Nexus expands into new projects and markets. If you enjoy being part of a team that moves quickly, solves problems, and takes pride in delivering a great experience for the people we serve, Nexus offers a different kind of Aramark career.

Location and Future On-Site Housing

This position will support a new project located near Hereford, Texas , within driving distance of both Hereford and Amarillo . Additional details regarding the specific work location will be shared with candidates as they move through the hiring process.

As the project develops, free on-site room and board is planned to become available for eligible employees . This will include housing and meals provided at no cost, creating an option for employees who prefer to live closer to the worksite rather than commute each day. Additional information about housing, availability, amenities, and timing will be provided as those services become available.

jobs.title: Human Resources Manager - Aramark Nexus
jobs.description:
Aramark Nexus is seeking experienced Human Resources Manager candidates who are interested in future HR leadership opportunities across Nexus locations throughout the United States. If you are a Human Resources Manager, HR Manager, HR Business Partner, HR Generalist Manager, Employee Relations Manager, People Operations Manager, Site HR Manager, Field HR Manager, or HR Operations Manager interested in joining Aramark Nexus, please apply to be considered for current and future opportunities.
Aramark Nexus opportunities are often located in remote or unique workforce community environments where our teams support large-scale hospitality, food service, facilities, residential, transportation, recreation, wellness, housekeeping, maintenance, retail, safety, and guest services operations. These roles are designed for HR leaders who are comfortable supporting fast-moving, people-centered operations where employees live, work, and serve guests on site.

The Human Resources Manager provides direct HR support to senior managers, department heads, operational leaders, and frontline teams. This role helps ensure managers and employees receive strong guidance, timely communication, practical support, and consistent application of HR policies, employee relations processes, staffing support, compliance expectations, training, and team engagement practices.

This is not a corporate-only HR role. Nexus is looking for hands-on HR leaders who can operate close to the work, build trust with leaders and employees, manage employee relations with sound judgment, support a strong operating culture, and help teams perform in complex residential hospitality environments.

The right candidate will bring strong HR experience, employee relations capability, operational understanding, sound communication skills, organization, discretion, and the ability to manage unstructured and diverse priorities. This opportunity is a strong fit for HR professionals who enjoy being a trusted partner to operations and who want to help build the future of workforce hospitality with Aramark Nexus.

If you are interested in future Human Resources Manager opportunities with Aramark Nexus, please apply.

Room and Board

Many Aramark Nexus opportunities are based in remote or residential workforce community locations. Depending on the assignment, Aramark employees may have access to free on-site accommodations as part of their employment.

These accommodations are designed to support employees working in unique operating environments where living on site may be part of the experience. Meals may also be included for Aramark staff while assigned to the location.

About Aramark Nexus

Aramark Nexus is redefining workforce communities for the industries building the future. Nexus develops and operates hospitality-driven workforce communities that support major infrastructure, energy, technology, and industrial projects across the United States.

Our communities provide housing, dining, recreation, wellness, transportation, housekeeping, facilities, guest services, and support services designed to create an exceptional living experience for residents working on critical projects.

Unlike traditional workforce housing operations, Nexus is built around a hospitality-first philosophy. We believe residents deserve an experience that feels more like a premium hotel or resort than a temporary work camp. Our teams create environments where people can recharge, connect, and perform at their best.

For candidates looking for Human Resources Manager, HR Business Partner, Employee Relations Manager, Site HR Manager, Field HR Manager, or People Operations leadership opportunities in remote, residential, hospitality, or workforce community environments, Aramark Nexus offers the opportunity to support meaningful work, develop strong teams, and help shape the employee experience in a growing business.

jobs.title: Field Sales Director II - East Region
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Field Sales Director II, Sales Growth Analytics & Field Performance is a leader responsible for driving revenue growth in Union Supply Group's Commissary Wholesale business by aligning field sales execution, commercial strategy, and advanced analytics. This role converts sales, pipeline, contract, and margin data into actionable priorities that improve seller effectiveness, speed-to-sale, off-contract distribution, and new market growth.
Partnering closely with Sales, Enablement, Pricing, Finance, and Operations, the Director standardizes performance planning and execution across state DOC, Federal BOP, and emerging markets. Success is measured by revenue attainment, pipeline health, forecast accuracy, margin discipline, contract retention, and field team development.
The role is field-forward with significant travel (40-60%) and ownership of centralized analytics, reporting, and forecasting.

Job Responsibilities

Analytics & Insight Generation
- Design and own a comprehensive sales analytics framework that quantifies growth drivers across market penetration, market development, and product development.
- Establish standardized definitions, formulas, and benchmarks for core commercial KPIs, including:
- Time-to-sale, win rate, stage conversion, pipeline coverage
- Average deal size, seller productivity, distribution breadth
- Off-contract SKU penetration, core item distribution, and margin performance

- Conduct cohort, funnel, and attribution analyses to identify:
- Seller effectiveness and coaching opportunities
- Account- and category-level assortment gaps
- Pricing, promotion, and offer-mix performance

- Translate analytics into clear, field-ready insights that guide account strategy, territory prioritization, and coaching conversations.
- Partner with Sales Enablement to embed insights into training programs, playbooks, and tools, and measure performance improvement over time.

Forecasting & Planning
- Own the end-to-end sales forecasting process (weekly, monthly, quarterly), integrating:
- Pipeline signals and deal velocity
- Historical performance and seasonality
- Contract renewal timelines and net-new opportunity flow

- Implement forecast models that reconcile bottom-up seller and territory inputs with top-down analytical projections.
- Establish forecast accuracy discipline by defining error thresholds, identifying variance drivers, and driving corrective actions with Sales and Finance leadership.
- Support territory planning, capacity modeling, and growth target setting aligned to strategic priorities and market opportunity.

Job Responsibilities

Pipeline Health & Sales Performance Management
- Create and maintain a pipeline inspection framework focused on:
- Coverage, quality, velocity, aging, and stage hygiene
- Clear stage-exit criteria and risk signals

- Publish seller, territory, and team scorecards that balance:
- Outcomes (revenue, win rate, margin, contract retention)
- Leading indicators (meetings, proposals, distribution gains, activity mix)

- Identify stalled deals, at-risk contracts, and coachable moments; operationalize deal and pipeline reviews with field leadership and Enablement.
- Support field sales leaders through:
- Ride-a longs and live account coaching
- Data-driven territory reviews
- Performance-based development plans

- Ensure analytics are actively used in the field to guide daily selling behavior and account prioritization.

Data Quality, Governance & Technology
- Establish governance standards for CRM and sales data, including definitions, ownership, lineage, and controls.
- Implement automated data quality processes (validation rules, required fields, duplicate management) to improve accuracy and usability.
- Own the sales analytics technology stack, including:
- Salesforce reporting and CRM data structures
- Power BI dashboards and Excel-based models
- Data pipelines and integration with enterprise data platforms

- Partner with Growth Enablement Technology to optimize tooling and leverage AI and automation to improve forecasting, pipeline scoring, and administrative efficiency.
- Ensure all sales and customer data comply with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, including access controls and audit trails.
- Continuously evaluate and implement enhancements that improve decision speed, insight adoption, and field usability.

Qualifications

Qualifications
- 10+ years of experience across Sales Analytics, Revenue Operations, Commercial Finance, and/or senior field sales leadership roles within multi-region organizations.
- Proven ownership of sales forecasting, executive reporting, and pipeline management processes.
- Deep expertise in Salesforce CRM, including opportunity management, stage definitions, and data hygiene.
- Advanced proficiency in Power BI, Microsoft Excel, and sales performance reporting.
- Demonstrated ability to translate analysis into action and influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong field orientation with the credibility to coach and partner with senior sales leaders.

Preferred
- Experience in wholesale distribution, CPG, or institutional/government sales; correctional commissary or DOC/BOP experience strongly preferred.
- Background in incentive compensation analytics, territory and capacity planning.
- Familiarity with machine learning or advanced statistical techniques for forecasting and scoring.
- Working knowledge of SQL and Python/R.
- Experience with pricing analytics, margin management, and offer profitability.
- Prior people leadership of multidisciplinary analytics or sales performance teams.

Education

jobs.title: Director of Marketing - Stone Mountain Hotel and Conference Center
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director of Marketing is responsible for creating and implementing an effective marketing program across all platforms that drive increased attendance to Stone Mountain Park. Additionally, this position manages the marketing team and oversees the advertising and digital agencies as well as serves as the brand steward for the Park. All other duties as assigned.

Job Responsibilities

- Develop and execute the annual marketing plan for all components of Stone Mountain Park including, but not limited to, Atlanta Evergreen Lakeside Resort, Stone Mountain Golf Club, Stone Mountain Campground, park attractions, events and festivals.
- Lead integrated marketing campaigns across paid media, digital marketing, CRM/email, social media, partnerships, public relations, and on-property promotions.
- Manage advertising strategy, media planning, agency relationships, and creative development to drive attendance, revenue, and brand awareness.
- Oversee brand management and ensure consistent messaging and visual standards across all marketing channels and customer touchpoints.
- Manage all owned digital channels, including websites, email marketing, online listings, and social media.
- Analyze campaign performance, website analytics, sales trends, and marketing ROI to optimize strategy.
- Lead internal marketing staff and external agency partners while coordinating cross-functional marketing projects.
- Direct marketing support for major seasonal festivals, attractions, special events, memberships, lodging, golf, and group sales.
- Assist in selecting, evaluating and making staff hiring decisions within the Marketing Department.
- Prepare all creative briefs for each major marketing campaign. Serve as the Park's brand champion to ensure the advertising and marketing communication is aligned to the brand strategy and exceeds our guests' expectations.
- Oversee all Park research and be the advocate for all consumer insight learning.
- Work closely with sales manager and team to determine business objectives and strategy to achieve best results.
- Represent the Park in key relationships with local industry groups, associations, and community officials.
- Oversee the development of the annual marketing budget, monitor progress, assure adherence and evaluate performance.
- Represent the Park in Corporate marketing initiatives including website and ticketing vendors.
- Ensure all marketing and ticketing initiatives are communicated clearly and effectively to all Park departments.
- Stay informed of developments in the marketing field as well as the entertainment industry and use this information to insure the Park and marketing is innovative and competitive.
- Directs all new product/attractions promotion and roll-out.
- Adhere to ARAMARK policies and procedures.
- Other duties assigned.

Qualifications

Ideal candidates will possess a bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or Advertising with an MBA desirable. Must have excellent communications skills, both written and verbal. Minimum of 8 years of experience working with theme parks and/or in the entertainment industry preferred. Must have experience working with the public.
Additional requirements include:
- Superior organizational, time management and communication skills required.
- Outstanding leadership skills and the ability to multi-task.
- Very good problem resolution techniques.
- Solid financial skills and accountability.
- Must be computer literate, proficient computer skills including MS Word, MS Excel and MS Outlook.
- Must be familiar with all areas of compliance relating to operating a fuel dock.
- Must be willing to work long hours, rotational shifts, weekends, holidays and have rotational days off.
- P&L accountability and/or contract-managed service experience is required.
- Ability to manage and maintain inventory/cost controls is required.
- Ability to deal effectively with customers and other company personnel. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers, guests or employees.
- Must be comfortable sitting, walking and standing for long periods of time.
- Experience with the following programs preferred: CMS software (WordPress and AEM), CRM systems (MailChimp, Inntopia, Revinate, Salesforce), PMS and CRS systems - hospitality (Opera, Synxis), Ticketing Systems (Gateway Galaxy, FareHarbor, Accesso), GA4, Canva and/or graphic design/video editing, and experience with social media platforms.

jobs.title: Vice President of Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Overview
The Vice President of Supply Chain will lead supply chain strategy and execution for the Corrections business, ensuring products flow reliably and efficiently across a complex, multi-site service environment. This leader will oversee demand and supply planning, replenishment, inventory management, supplier service performance, product flow, and working capital optimization. The role will partner closely with Procurement, Category Management, Operations, Finance, distribution partners, and field leadership to improve availability, service, cost, and supply continuity.

Job Responsibilities

- Develop and execute the supply chain strategy in alignment with Corrections business priorities, client commitments, growth objectives, and financial goals.
- Lead demand planning, supply planning, replenishment, inventory management, purchasing execution, product flow, transfers, and dropship operations; own forecast accuracy and demand-plan quality.
- Own inventory performance, including inventory levels, turns, days of supply, working capital, excess and obsolete inventory, and stockout reduction; reducing unfilled item demand and maintaining accurate, right-sized inventory quantities.
- Lead root-cause analysis and corrective-action processes for unfilled demand, stockouts, excess inventory, forecast misses, and supplier service failures, with clear functional ownership and measurable recovery plans.
- Establish and govern inventory and replenishment policies, including min/max levels, safety stock, reorder points, lead-time assumptions, service-level targets, and exception management to optimize product availability while minimizing working capital and excess inventory.
- Establish demand exception-management processes for new items, contract wins/losses, mobilizations, significant customer orders, discontinued items, and material deviations from historical demand to protect inventory availability and working capital.
- Lead SKU rationalization efforts, including review of Tier C and D products, to simplify the assortment and reduce carrying costs.
- Lead the supply-side component of S&OP/SIOP processes, aligning demand, inventory, supply capacity, and financial plans.
- Ensure reliable product availability across a geographically dispersed network of correctional facilities and related distribution channels.
- Partner with Procurement and Category Management on supplier requirements while maintaining clear accountability between supply chain execution and strategic sourcing.
- Partner with Procurement and Category Management to establish supplier service requirements and SLAs, including lead time, fill rate, OTIF, capacity, quality, and continuity expectations, and hold suppliers accountable for operational performance.
- Monitor and improve supplier service, capacity, lead-time reliability, fill rates, and on-time, in-full performance; escalate and resolve material supply risks.
- Develop business continuity and supply risk mitigation plans to support essential operations during shortages, disruptions, mobilizations, and demand shifts.
- Provide strategic oversight of transportation, distribution, and network flow to improve service and total delivered cost.
- Drive process standardization, data visibility, planning discipline, and technology adoption across supply chain operations.
- Develop and manage inventory and supply chain financial plans, including inventory investment, working capital, excess and obsolete inventory exposure, service-cost tradeoffs, and productivity commitments in partnership with Finance.
- Establish performance dashboards and operating rhythms for forecast accuracy, fill rate, OTIF, inventory turns, days of supply, stockouts, working capital, supplier service, and total supply chain cost.
- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, geographically dispersed team with clear accountability and a continuous improvement mindset.
- Partner with field operations and functional leaders to translate client and operational requirements into practical supply chain solutions.
- Communicate supply chain performance, risks, tradeoffs, and corrective actions to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
- Extensive progressive leadership experience in supply chain, inventory planning, replenishment, distribution, logistics, or operations.
- Experience leading supply chain operations in a large, complex, multi-site environment; foodservice, hospitality, distribution, retail, facilities services, healthcare, or corrections experience preferred.
- Demonstrated success improving inventory productivity, working capital, service levels, forecast accuracy, and supply continuity.
- Strong understanding of demand planning, supply planning, replenishment, inventory optimization, supplier performance, logistics, and S&OP/SIOP.
- Demonstrated experience establishing inventory planning disciplines, including demand forecasting, safety stock, min/max parameters, replenishment policies, and exception-based inventory management in a high-SKU distribution environment.
- Financial acumen with the ability to evaluate cost, service, inventory, and working capital tradeoffs.
- Experience leading transformation, process standardization, technology enablement, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Strong analytical skills and experience using planning, inventory, and reporting systems to drive decisions and accountability; experience with HIMpact or similar inventory/procurement systems preferred, and familiarity with Oracle Fusion or comparable large-scale ERP platforms is a plus.
- Executive-level communication and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively across Operations, Procurement, Finance, and other functional teams.
- Proven ability to lead and develop senior leaders and geographically dispersed teams.
- Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment, manage competing priorities, and lead through ambiguity and change.
- Ability to travel based on business needs

jobs.description:
Job Description

Healthcare+ is looking for a VPO to support multi-service accounts in the Central region. Reporting to the Regional Vice President, this Vice President of Operations (VPO) is responsible for the overall operation of multiple accounts or a significant multi-site account normally generating $80M+ in revenue. This individual will be accountable for galvanizing a team under a common growth and operations platform, and ultimately drive improvement in operational efficiency, revenue, margin, and client retention for each account in the overall portfolio. The VPO will work to continuously ensure the organization is delivering operational excellence, while also identifying innovative and creative services and solutions to expand on our clients' requirements, working closely with internal and external partners. The incumbent of this position will develop and maintain the overall strategy, priorities and direction for operations within the area.

Job Responsibilities

- Manage all facets of the area including sales, finance, human resources, and customer service including full P&L accountability.

- Drive new sales growth within existing client base and ensure the delivery of exceptional customer service to our clients.

- Develop short- and long-term operational strategies in partnership with senior team members and lead the design, development, and execution of those strategies to achieve measurable outcomes in a timely, cost-effective manner.

- Lead and manage a highly productive, motivated and driven team through strong communication, empowerment, reward, and coaching techniques. Maintain close working relationships with partner group in functional areas, including Sales, Human Resources, Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Compliance.

- Partner with the business unit leaders and other key stakeholders to inspire change and implement new business processes.

Qualifications

To be prepared for this important leadership role, qualified candidates will possess:
- Bachelor's degree required, master's degree desired

- Minimum of 10-12 years of progressive responsibility, successful experience in general management with full P&L responsibility; food, facilities, or retail service sector preferred.

- Proven leadership and experience with managing effective client relationships that are high, wide and deep.

- Demonstrated leadership skills including broad knowledge of management practices and good business analysis/project management skills.

- Demonstrated ability to grasp a large, complex, global business at a base level and use this understanding to set overall strategy and drive business process improvement.

- Adept business savvy to effectively communicate and work with other executives in support of achieving business and systems goals.

- Strong business planning skills to complete strategic projects with implications for business areas with rapidly evolving business processes. Must possess a balanced perspective on strategic and tactical issues.

- Proven ability to manage numerous projects, as well as resources, remotely in a highly dispersed organization.

- Established ability to select top talent and create a productive environment that promotes initiative, innovation, continuous learning, and development of key leaders for future advancement.

jobs.title: Operations Lead, Early Careers
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Operations Lead, Early Careers is responsible for operational execution and planning of Aramark's early career recruitment & programming: Management Accelerator Program (MAP), Aramark Internship Program and Drexel Co-Op Program. This role drives process optimization, standardization and scalability. The Operations Lead reports to the Director, Early Careers, providing strategic support for both recruiting and programming in cross-program initiatives, data management, and reporting. A person who will be well-prepared to succeed in this role will be highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to run multiple workstreams at once across a matrixed organization.
This position will report to the Director, Early Careers and is based in Aramark's Headquarters in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Limited travel may be required and is not expected to exceed 25% during peak times.

Job Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end operational planning across MAP, Internship and Co-Op programs, for both Recruiting and Programming pillars. Build project plans, define milestones, track dependencies, flag risk, and drive on-time delivery, partnering with the Recruiting Lead and Programming Lead who own execution within their functions
- Own the master Early Careers calendar and timeline across Recruiting and Programming (fiscal calendar, program milestones, Interview Day windows, MAP summit dates, etc.), ensuring both functions are planning with one integrated view
- Design and maintain the scheduling infrastructure and process for Interview Day logistics (tools, templates, communications for interviewers/candidates, systems), building the system
- Recruiting uses to execute
- Build and own reporting infrastructure across both functions: demand planning trackers, candidate flow, survey/NPS instruments and analysis, program metrics, and dashboards that roll up to the Director and are shared with executive stakeholders
- Design the communications calendar and process framework for recruiting and programming communications (cadence, templates, approvals), partnering with functional leads on content
- Own Philadelphia-based Drexel Co-Op Program recruitment and management, driving consistency of experience across participants and managers
- Coordinate large events (e.g., MAP summit). Support timeline, logistics framework, stakeholder coordination, etc., partnering with Programming Lead on content and delivery
- Identify process gaps or inefficiencies across Recruiting and Programming and design standardized, scalable solutions
- Partner with HRIT on system and data needs (application/interview tooling, reporting integration) as the operational owner of those requirements
- Support budget tracking and expense management for Early Careers programs
- Facilitate cross-functional working sessions to keep Recruiting, Programming, and the Director aligned on plan status
- Surface operational risks to the Director with recommended solutions, before they become escalations
- Drive process optimization and standardization across programs to support scalability and expansion
- Provide strategic support to the Director on special projects, cross-program initiatives, and stakeholder updates

Qualifications

- 3-5+ years in project management or operations/event/logistics roles with increasing planning/ownership scope; TA or HR experience preferred but not required
- Bachelor's Degree in Business, HR, Operations Management or related field, or equivalent experience
- Demonstrated ability to build and manage systems (calendars, trackers, reporting) that help teams plan and deliver at scale
- Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional work with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
- Demonstrated problem-solving skills using analytics, judgment, and interpretation based on available information
- Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain quality under tight deadlines
- Strong ability to influence others without formal authority
- Experience with data/reporting tools and translating data into recommendations
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint) and project management tools
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while knowing when to escalate issues
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director, Human Resources is a business leader and HR practitioner who translates Refreshments strategy into actionable people outcomes across the Central, West, and SoCal Regions. Reporting into the Refreshments HRVP, the HRD partners with regional and operations leaders to achieve targeted business results, leads and develops a team of HR professionals, and delivers core HR programs with excellence.
HR guidance from this role is proactive, data-informed, business-grounded, and consistently aligned to Aramark leadership behaviors. The HRD is a trusted advisor to Regional Vice Presidents, Vice Presidents of Operations, and both operation and functional leadership teams, a steward of talent and culture, a visible change agent, and an independent decision-maker on complex employee and labor relations matters.

Job Responsibilities

- Being a key member of the operations leadership teams across the Central, West, and SoCal regions working to achieve targeted business outcomes
- Providing direct support to key functional groups including Growth, Marketing and Operational Excellence
- Driving regional and line-of-business HR strategy execution
- Building performance-based relationships with regional leaders and local operations teams
- Strategic consultation to leadership on organizational design, change, talent, and engagement
- Efficient delivery of core HR programs, including performance management, compensation planning, and talent reviews
- Participation in enterprise initiatives and partnership with Centers of Excellence (COEs)
- Serving as a change agent for programs and processes; identifying and escalating challenges quickly
- Leading and developing HR professionals
- Supporting complex labor and employee relations matters

Business Partnership

- Understand the line of business P&L and connect HR actions to business results

- Partner early with the relevant COE on new enterprise programs so field le

Job Description

The Operations Finance Manager will support the objectives of the Finance department by leading and directing all aspects of financial operations, including forecasting, budgeting, reporting, labor and inventory controls, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and credit/collections. This position will oversee the finance and administrative functions to ensure accuracy, policy compliance, outstanding customer service, and continuous process improvement.

The Finance Manager will supervise and develop the finance and office staff while maintaining a strong internal control environment and supporting operational leadership. The role will also partner closely with Regional Finance leadership on compliance, organizational initiatives, and operational financial reviews.

This is a full-time, onsite position (Monday through Friday) in Denver, CO; remote or hybrid work arrangements are not available.
The ideal candidate will have a strong operational finance background, outstanding Excel skills, and a proven track record of financial leadership in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Compensation Data

COMPENSATION: The Salaried rate for this position is $85,000.00 to $110,000.00. If both numbers are the same, that is the amount that Aramark expects to offer. This is Aramark's good faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation for this position as of the time of posting.

BENEFITS: Aramark offers comprehensive benefit programs and services for eligible employees including medical, dental, vision, and work/life resources. Additional benefits may include retirement savings plans like 401(k) and paid days off such as parental leave and disability coverage. Benefits vary by location and are subject to any legal requirements or limitations, employee eligibility status, and where the employee lives and/or works. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all applicable laws, including, but not limited to all applicable Fair Chance Ordinances and Acts. - Manage and complete all aspects of the month-end close process, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards, company policies, and internal controls (including SOX compliance where applicable).
- Supervise and develop office and finance staff, including hiring, training, mentoring, and performance management to build a strong finance organization.
- Maintain a strong focus on providing outstanding internal and external customer service, including billing accuracy, compliance with contractual obligations, and timely/comprehensive collection of outstanding balances.

- Proactively resolve financial issues and advance unresolved accounts or concerns to appropriate leadership.
- Perform other duties as assigned to meet business needs.

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in finance, accounting, and supervising teams.
- Prior experience in a Controller, Finance Manager, or equivalent operational finance role in a market center or similar environment is strongly preferred.
- Strong operational finance experience across accounts payable, accounts receivable, credit control, payroll, and inventory processes.
- Considerable knowledge of accounting standards, practices, and procedures.
- Strong analytical, reporting, and financial modeling skills.
- Excellent proficiency with Excel (required); experience with Oracle or other financial systems preferred.

Regional Director of Operations
New York | New Jersey | Pennsylvania

Lead Operations. Develop Teams. Strengthen Client Partnerships.

We are seeking a relationship-focused, results-driven Regional Director of Operations to lead a portfolio of healthcare and senior living communities throughout New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania.

Job Description

As a General Manager you will provide overall vision, planning, direction, and control to assigned sites for a defined account. This key leadership role is accountable for execution of our General Management program, with a focus on growth, cost and productivity, leading people and delivering financial commitments. Key success measures include Revenue Growth, EBIT, Margin, Customer Satisfaction, Client Loyalty and Employee Engagement. Please note, this position works on weekends .
Leadership - Overall ownership and accountability of operational management and financial performance of multiple accounts and units. Model key leadership behaviors and ensure the highest levels of safety, quality and service excellence for employees, clients, and customers. Coach employees by creating a shared understanding about what needs to be achieved and how it is to be achieved. Reward and recognize employees (examples or programs) Identify, develop and engage top talent and coach team members to their fullest potential within the organization. Plan and lead team management meetings. Ensure HS&E standards in all operations and that those standards meet or exceed client metrics.

Client Relationship - Establish and maintain effective client and customer rapport for a mutually beneficial business relationship. Identify client needs and communicate operational progress. Facilitate and support new business and retention activities. Ensure unit managers execute customer satisfaction surveys in all locations. Ensure timely and accurate monthly site level business reviews with client site Leadership. Support Account Leadership in the development of timely and accurate QBRs with the requisite date and performance data. Responsible for all contractual obligations at the assigned sites which would include KPI performance .

Financial Performance - Build revenue and manage budget which includes cost controls. Ensure the completion and maintenance of P&L statements for the district. Oversight and responsibility to deliver client and company financial targets. Ensure adoption of all Aramark processes and systems, eliminate custom/manual reports. Understand performance metrics, data, order and inventory trends; educate teams on key levers to improve margins.

The Account Lead serves as the strategic and operational leader for a higher education dining program, providing overall vision, direction, and oversight for residential dining, retail operations, catering, and campus hospitality services. Leadership & Strategic Direction
- Provide overall leadership, planning, and direction for all dining service operations within the assigned account.
- Develop and execute strategic initiatives that support operational excellence, revenue growth, guest satisfaction, and client objectives.
- Lead and inspire teams through a culture of accountability, engagement, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
- Model and reinforce Harvest Table's core values, leadership principles, and commitment to hospitality.

Operations Management
- Oversee the daily operation of residential dining, retail food venues, catering services, and campus hospitality programs.
- Ensure consistent delivery of exceptional food quality, service standards, and guest experiences.
- Drive compliance with all food safety, sanitation, health, and regulatory requirements.

- Develop and execute action plans to improve margins, productivity, and overall financial results.

- Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, P&Ls, forecasting, and cost controls.
- Knowledge of state and federal food safety regulations and standards applicable to higher education dining.

jobs.title: Vice President of Operations - First Class Vending
jobs.description:
About First Class Vending

First Class Vending, now part of Aramark Refreshments, has been Southern California's leader in vending and micro-market solutions for over 30 years. We deliver inspired break experiences through a full portfolio of snacks, coffee, tea, cold brew, and fresh food options, all tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients. Backed by Aramark's national scale and expertise, our local team continues to create welcoming spaces where employees and guests can recharge, connect, and enjoy a true sense of community.

Compensation Data

COMPENSATION: The Salaried rate for this position is $185,000.00 to $210,000.00. If both numbers are the same, that is the amount that Aramark expects to offer. This is Aramark's good faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation for this position as of the time of posting.

BENEFITS: Aramark offers comprehensive benefit programs and services for eligible employees including medical, dental, vision, and work/life resources. Additional benefits may include retirement savings plans like 401(k) and paid days off such as parental leave and disability coverage. Benefits vary by location and are subject to any legal requirements or limitations, employee eligibility status, and where the employee lives and/or works. For more information about Aramark benefits, click here Aramark Careers - Benefits & Compensation

There is no predetermined application window for this position, the position will close once a qualified candidate is selected. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all applicable laws, including, but not limited to all applicable Fair Chance Ordinances and Acts. For jobs in San Francisco, this includes the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Job Description

We are seeking a dynamic, results-driven Vice President of Operations for First Class Vending to lead our Southern California business into its next phase of operational excellence, profitable growth, and organizational development.

Reporting to the Regional Vice President of Aramark Refreshments, this leader will have full accountability for business performance, operational execution, client retention, and talent development across a multi-location portfolio. The business is primarily focused on traditional vending and micro-market operations, complemented by office coffee and refreshment services.

This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role requiring strong financial acumen, operational discipline, and the ability to translate strategy into measurable results. The successful candidate will build a high-performing leadership team, strengthen accountability throughout the organization, and drive continuous improvement while preserving the local relationships and service culture that define First Class Vending.

This is an in-person role based in Bell Gardens, California, with responsibility for operations throughout Southern California, including multiple locations outside of Bell Gardens. Regular travel throughout the territory and a strong presence in field operations are expected. Hybrid and remote work arrangements are not available.

Business Performance & Operational Excellence

Business Strategy & Financial Performance
- Own the overall financial and operational performance of First Class Vending, with full P&L accountability for revenue, profitability, operating expenses, and business results.
- Develop and execute business strategies that accelerate profitable growth, improve margins, and strengthen operational performance.
- Establish clear business priorities, performance expectations, and accountability measures across all locations and leadership teams.
- Leverage financial reporting, operational metrics, and business intelligence to identify performance gaps, implement corrective actions, and deliver measurable improvements.
- Ensure disciplined management of labor, inventory, product costs, capital investments, and other key financial drivers.

Operational Excellence
- Drive consistent execution of operating standards across vending, micro-market, and office coffee service operations.
- Lead initiatives that improve route productivity, asset utilization, equipment reliability, inventory management, service quality, and cost efficiency.
- Strengthen operational processes and controls to improve profitability, reduce waste, and sustain performance improvements.
- Maintain a strong field presence across Market Centers, branches, routes, and client locations to evaluate execution, address challenges, and reinforce accountability.
- Champion safety, food safety, regulatory compliance, and operational standards throughout the organization.

Growth, Leadership & Strategic Execution

Growth & Client Experience
- Partner with Sales and lead business development leaders to accelerate new business growth, expand existing accounts, and strengthen market presence.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, ensuring exceptional service, client satisfaction, and long-term retention.
- Drive improvements in consumer experience, merchandising effectiveness, product offerings, and location-level revenue performance.
- Identify opportunities to optimize existing locations, expand services, and strengthen the overall value delivered to clients.
- Ensure new business growth is supported by effective mobilization, operational readiness, and sustainable service delivery.

Leadership & Organizational Development
- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing management team, establishing clear ownership of business results, leadership effectiveness, and operational expectations.
- Evaluate organizational structure, leadership capabilities, and resource alignment to ensure the business is positioned for long-term success.
- Build a strong talent pipeline through performance management, leadership development, succession planning, and employee engagement.
- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational ownership at every level of the organization.
- Maintain meaningful connections with frontline employees and field leaders, creating an environment where employees feel supported, valued, and empowered to deliver results.

Strategic Execution & Partnership
- Translate business priorities into actionable plans with clear ownership, disciplined execution, and measurable outcomes.
- Lead operational and organizational change initiatives that strengthen business performance and support sustainable growth.
- Collaborate with Finance, Human Resources, Sales, Supply Chain, Marketing, Safety, and Compliance to align resources and achieve business objectives.
- Serve as a strategic partner to regional and enterprise leadership, providing business insights, performance updates, and recommendations.
- Balance immediate operational demands with long-term objectives, demonstrating sound judgment, adaptability, and decisive leadership.

Developing new skills and doing what it takes to get the job done positively impacts our employees and customers. In order to meet our commitments, job duties may change, or new ones may be assigned without formal notice.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
- Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible leadership experience, including significant multi-site operational management and full P&L accountability.
- Experience in vending, micro-markets, unattended retail, route-based distribution, or related service operations strongly preferred.
- Demonstrated success improving profitability, operational efficiency, revenue growth, and client retention across complex, geographically dispersed operations.
- Proven ability to lead organizational change, establish performance accountability, and drive sustainable operational improvements.
- Strong financial and analytical acumen, including experience leveraging P&L statements, operating metrics, and business data to guide decision-making.
- Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing management teams, including talent assessment and succession planning.
- Strong understanding of route productivity, inventory controls, labor management, service execution, and asset optimization.
- Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills across frontline employees, clients, business partners, and executive leadership.
- Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on operational execution in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.
- Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout Southern California, and to other locations outside the region.
